targets.outcome_quote: In a conceptual replication of Jokela et al. (2016), results closely resembled the original study: sleep problems, energy level, and weight/appetite changes were associated with CRP (2a).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly describe the conceptual replication as closely resembling the original for all three symptom links. Additional covariate models are extensions, with no explicit failure contrast to Jokela.

reasoning: Different cohort data conceptually replicate Jokela et al.; other symptom studies are contextual comparisons rather than designated targets.
